payload.title: Declare PyYAML for clean-runner offline tests
payload.description: GitHub Actions run37325144808 failed before specs ran: unified_bundles_test.py imports yaml but dev install lacks PyYAML. Specs-first declare the actual test dependency; validate clean temporary install with dev extras and offline make test, then GitHub CI. Do not skip away working runtime specs or add credentials/network calls to tests. Terra implementation, root review/publication.
